## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `<type>/<description>` and was cut from an up-to-date `main`
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run pytest` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, channel PSKs, or personal location data included
- [ ] Docs / `CLAUDE.md` / ADR updated if a convention, command, or decision changed
- [ ] PR is small enough to review in one sitting (split it if not)
